faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Assistant position at IIM Lucknow is 04-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree or MBA from a reputed institute or university in a regular mode, with a minimum of 60% marks to be eligible for the Research Assistant position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post in the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Research Assistant position in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role at IIM Lucknow?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant position involves the scrutiny of applications followed by an online interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant position at IIM Lucknow is a contractual job. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as specified in the appointment letter.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow, situated in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 226013.
